newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia upgrades Kolenergo, Kubanenergo to RTS.
newsitem.headline: Russia upgrades Kolenergo, Kubanenergo to RTS.

text.p: The ordinary and preferred shares in regional power utilities Kolenergo and the common shares in Kubanenergo have been transferred to the Russian Trading System (RTS) from the RTS-2 from March 3, Russia's National Association of Stock Market Participants said on Tuesday.
The move upgrades the shares to a more liquid category, since the RTS-2 is dedicated to less liquid stocks.
The association has also included the common shares in the OAO Pavlovsky Avtobus bus factory into RTS-2 and removed the shares of the Rostvertol helicopter factory from the list.
